cells.L5/L12/L24/L40: experiments.chain_agents.build_population(None, t, L, seed=0, noise=True), 6 tasks, 4 faults each

methods.phylo: contrastive_localize (default ContrastiveConfig: sibling='content', tau=0.9, top_k=4), no LLM
methods.matched-phylo: llm_baselines.matched_judge with reference = PhyloAgent's selected sibling
methods.matched-random-s{k}: matched_judge with a uniformly random successful reference, seed k (det_seed('matched-random', cell, run_id, k))
methods.matched-first: matched_judge with reference = pop.successes[0] (human benchmark only)

design.scoring: agent_correct = pred.agent == ann.responsible_agent; step_correct = pred.step == ann.decisive_step (run_contrastive._score); unparseable judge answers -> (<unparsed>, -1) -> incorrect
design.stats: 95% Wilson score intervals (scipy binomtest.proportion_ci); exact binomial McNemar (scipy binomtest, cross-checked vs evaluate.mcnemar); Holm-Bonferroni (evaluate.holm_bonferroni) with family = the 4 length cells per judge per comparison; Cohen's h (evaluate.cohens_h)
